# GetEnv <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
GetEnv:String env_var:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env_var` | In | String | required | The name of the variable. |

**Returns:** The value of an environment variable, or an empty string when it is not set.

## Description

_Not documented yet._

## Examples

```blitzbasic
SetEnv "WIKI_EXAMPLE", "hello"
Print GetEnv$("WIKI_EXAMPLE")
```

```text
hello
```
